specification.title: Contradictory context yields separately cited claims
specification.description: Contradictory context: both fixtures' techniques are supplied and both sides must be represented as separately cited claims with no verdict/winner semantics.
specification.purpose: Verify both contradicting technique contexts are represented as separately cited claims with no verdict or winner semantics.
specification.operational_relevance: Research must preserve source disagreement for downstream analysts instead of picking a winner.
specification.regression_risk: The agent could emit one claim, drop one side, or add verdict semantics to the claims.

required: Claims cite both contradiction sides with their required phrases
forbidden: One side of the contradiction is dropped or the claims declare a winner
